findings.title: Parent probe exit 0 is not an all-checks gate; false flags are probe defects with zero credit
findings.detail: Parent probes/binding-probe.py SHA-256 6ccafe133f2058d1e2c413ca09427a86d24a82330c202b5a59fab196e330a3fe called sys.exit(0) unconditionally. It recorded midnight_summary.all_members_match false and four static byte_check false flags. Independent inspection: Midnight receipt paths are relative to p31-zkir-dependency-source-preparation, but the parent resolved extracted=packet/rec[path]. blst paths are packet-relative and matched. Static failures used 0-based indexes that missed 1-based lines 489-490 (preprocess inputs/outputs), 785 (assert public_inputs[1]), 558 (PoseidonChip init), and two-limbs-per-line BLS12_381_r constants. Those parent flags receive zero credit. They are not crate defects. Root's prior 464/159 member replay remains separate evidence.

findings.title: Commitment preimage order, field aliases, Poseidon init, and Fq/blst limbs bind snapshotted bytes
findings.detail: transient_commit pushes opening first. FieldRepr for [Fr] writes the raw slice without a length prefix. ZKIR preprocess extends inputs then outputs. Circuit builds opening then inputs then outputs, poses, and asserts public_inputs[1]. CPU and circuit PoseidonChip both init Some(inputs.len()). Wrapper Fr is outer::Scalar=midnight_curves::Fq. Embedded scalar is midnight_curves::Fr and must not be substituted. Fq wraps blst_fr; modulus 0x73eda753299d7d483339d80809a1d80553bda402fffe5bfeffffffff00000001 agrees with little-endian limbs and blst BLS12_381_r. blst_fr_mul binds mul_mont_sparse_256. These are source-navigation facts. No generated-constraint correspondence or runtime execution is claimed.

findings.title: PiSkip preprocess adjusts transcript cursor; circuit arm is empty
findings.detail: ir_vm.rs preprocess on a false guard pushes a skip and subtracts count from public_transcript_inputs_idx; the other branch checks associated public-transcript values. Circuit match arm is I::PiSkip { .. } => {}. That empty arm is a witness/public-instance/skip correspondence boundary for a later interface contract. It is not by itself a soundness proof or a circuit bug. Source index/resource assumptions and bounded-integer-to-Fq refinement remain explicit adapter work.

findings.title: Failed blst attempt1 matcher is retained with zero credit; attempt2 verified 159 members and seven anchors
findings.detail: Unanchored needle pub fn blst_fr_mul matches bindings.rs:265 blst_fr_mul_by_3 and :274 blst_fr_mul. Attempt1 credit false. Attempt2 needle pub fn blst_fr_mul( is unique at 274, with unique add/mul exports, BLS12_381_r, and build.rs portable/ADX selection lines. Navigation.json historically listed blst 0.3.16 as uncaptured. Later capture closes that named source gap, not the remaining lock closure. build.rs platform/feature/assembly selection is unverified for any installed binary.

findings.title: License and VCS fields are heterogeneous source metadata, not a legal review
findings.detail: Several Cargo.toml.orig files inherit license from workspace. midnight-circuits and midnight-zk-stdlib use license-file.workspace; receipt license is null; registry says non-standard; extracted LICENSE files are Apache-2.0 SHA-256 c71d239df91726fc519c6eb72d318ec65820627232b2f796219e87dcf35d0ab4. Other packages carry Apache-2.0, MIT/Apache-2.0, or MIT OR Apache-2.0 in registry/receipt. Not every package contains a standalone LICENSE. blst is Apache-2.0 with VCS e7f90de551e8df682f3cc99067d204d8b90d27ad path_in_vcs bindings/rust. Receipt VCS objects agree with extracted .cargo_vcs_info.json.

findings.title: Thirteen named crates are not a complete Cargo/build closure
findings.detail: Captured set is 12 midnight-* packages plus blst 0.3.16. midnight-zkir 2.1.0 remains the earlier source packet, excluded from this Midnight acquisition by design. 333 other lock packages remain. All captures are pure acquisition: no circuits, proofs, keys, or real execution. Old mock artifact execution is historical. These additions cannot close adapter 32.7, review 32.9, full P31, P19, P20, or the full program. Tasks 32.1-4 stay historical readiness records.
